source: Hand-compiled from the sources named on each row; read 9 Oct 2026, the solstice rows 19 Nov 2026
note: Egypt's public holidays and the lunar dates that move every year. Fixed-date holidays are firm. Every Islamic date is a forecast from astronomical calculation and is confirmed only by the official moon sighting (Dar al-Ifta) — so each lunar row carries a range, not a day, and is marked expected. No official Egyptian government list for 2027 had been published when this was compiled; the rows below come from named secondary calendars, and where they disagree the range covers both.

events.name: Karnak winter solstice sunrise
events.note: Not a public holiday. Africanews, reporting with AP, says the sunrise lines up with the temple walls on 21 December, the shortest day of the year, and visitors gather at dawn to watch it.
events.source: Africanews with AP: Egypt: Visitors watch sun align with ancient Luxor temple on winter solstice (22 Dec 2025)

events.name: Qasr Qarun winter solstice sunrise
events.name_ar: تعامد الشمس على معبد قصر قارون
events.note: Not a public holiday. Explore Fayoum, a Fayoum travel site, describes the sun lining up with this Ptolemaic temple on 21 December; a second travel site gives about 25 minutes of light in the sanctuary.
events.source: Explore Fayoum: Qasr Qaroun Temple Sun Festival, 21 December

events.note: Some calendars list a substitute day off on 28 January.
events.source: HolidayDB — Public holidays in 2027 in Egypt

events.name: Ramadan
events.note: Gulf News and The National (Oct 2026) give 8 February from astronomical calculation; Egypt-specific holiday calendars (TrueCalendar, Calendarific) list 9 February. 29 or 30 days, set by moon sighting.
events.source: The National, 6 Oct 2026 — Ramadan 2027 expected dates

events.name: Abu Simbel sun alignment
events.name_ar: تعامد الشمس على معبد أبو سمبل
events.note: Not a public holiday. The Ministry's ticket list gives a separate ticket for the sun alignment day: 1,200 EGP for a foreign adult, against 750 on other days. Its booking site showed 1,272 EGP when we checked on 17 November 2026.
events.source: Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities price list (5 Nov 2024): Celebrating the Sun Alignment on 22 October/22 February
